reduction: Ghosh's two formulas (the database's formula 2, stated for 0.198–2.0531 µm) evaluated at each wavelength of 380–780 nm every 5 nm and averaged in the dielectric function for randomly oriented grains, n² = (2n_o² + n_e²) ÷ 3, to six significant figures; k = 0, stated, since the sources give n only. The trigonal crystal is taken over fused silica (I. H. Malitson, J. Opt. Soc. Am. 55 (1965) 1205: n 1.460 at 550 nm, against this file's 1.549), which is recorded as the alternative: which form a condensate takes is not modelled; 295 K stands for the source's room temperature
